master.title: Mya - Aviointeriors
master.content:
Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication

Mya is the result of decennial experience in aircraft seat manufacturing and offers the maximum comfort at minimum pitch.

Less is more

Mya is designed to meet the latest Airlines stringent requirements in terms of light-weighting, reliability, maintenance cost efficiency without compromise on comfort and style.
